welcome.title: Pick a color, tap the matching squares.

handedness.sectionTitle: Which side should the controls use?

welcome.note: You can change this later in Settings.

beats.mismatchedTap: Tap the highlighted different cell. Wrong taps cost nothing.
beats.undoAction: Undo that stitch, then place it again.
beats.stitchSweep: Press a matching cell, then drag across the highlighted run.
beats.threadColorCompletion: Finish the highlighted white thread, then choose your next color.

hints.anchoredZoom: Pinch to zoom while keeping the cells under your fingers in place.
hints.panVsSweep: Dragging pans the fabric. Start on a matching cell to stitch a sweep.
hints.edgeAutoPan: Keep sweeping near the edge and the fabric follows your finger.
hints.remainingCellLocator: Use the locator to find the next remaining cell for this thread.

lines.matchNumbers: Match the numbers to place each stitch.
lines.dragSweep: Drag across matching cells to sweep.
lines.pinchZoom: Pinch to zoom when you need a closer look.
lines.undoLocator: Undo and the locator are always free.
